notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]More gameplay options (including optional timers and map sizes), UI improvements and bug fixes[/b]

We've made some changes following your great feedback! Here's a list of everything that's changed in version 1.1:

[list]
[*] You can choose some gameplay parameters when starting a new single player game:
    - Turn timer can be set to 60, 90, 120 or unlimited
    - Map size can be set to small, medium or large
    - You can choose to be the one who always ends the turn (even during a building turn)
[*]Hovering the mouse over a resource in the top-left panel will show the rate at which you are gathering that resource
[*]Units are partially visible (semi-transparent) when they are behind buildings and trees
[*]When placing a card, you can move the mouse to the edge of the screen to scroll
[*]Horseman stats changed:
    - Changed the base HP from 4 to 8
    - Increased the unit's gold cost from 25 to 32
    - Decreased the effect of the HP upgrade from 5 to 4
[*]The Select Unit button (or F key) will select any units that have not moved first, followed by those that have not taken any actions
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause tamed animals to be unable to attack in some circumstances
[*]Fixed the "polar opposites" achievement 
[*]Fixed rare crash when loading the menu
[/list]

notes.title: Cardlings is set for release
notes.notes:
Get ready to outwit your opponents in our latest tactical game.

Cardlings is coming on [b]June 5th[/b] for Windows, Mac and Linux.

A tablet version (Android and iOS) will follow soon for proper cross-platform multiplayer.
